entities.name: Zygmunt Szczęsny Feliński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zygmunt Szczęsny Feliński was a professor of the Saint Petersburg Roman Catholic Theological Academy, Archbishop of Warsaw in 1862-1883, and founder of the Franciscan Sisters of the Family of Mary. He was canonised on 11 October 2009 by Pope Benedict XVI.
